rent.note: Furnished studio/1BR on a 1–3 month term. The usual Korean lease (wolse) needs a deposit of 10–20x the rent and an ARC, so it isn't practical for visitors. Airbnb whole-unit monthly prices for Nov 2026 start around $735–1,130 in Seomyeon and $980–1,350 in Haeundae (quartile 1 is about $1,660–1,800). Korean short-let platforms (33m2) are probably cheaper but couldn't be read. Wise's long-lease 1BR is £484 (about $640).

utilities.note: Short-term officetel and Airbnb rates usually include internet and building maintenance. This budgets for electricity and gas overage (summer air-con, winter ondol). Wise's full-flat figure is £128 plus £20 internet for 85 m².

groceries.note: Home cooking. Korean fruit and produce are expensive. Wise's £361 per person (about $477) looks high for a solo cook who also eats out, so this is set between Osaka ($260) and Wise.

diningOut.note: Derived: about 18 meals at about $9 (gukbap and dwaeji-gukbap places, Wise inexpensive meal £5) plus about 15 café coffees at about $4.

transit.note: Metro KRW 1,600 per section-1 ride by card (bus 1,550). 40 rides is about KRW 64,000 ($47) plus the odd taxi.

coworking.note: WeWork Busan (BIFC, Seomyeon) coworking membership from KRW 263,500/month (list KRW 310,000), about $196 at 1,347.39 KRW/USD. Local independents and Busan's public workation centre can be cheaper.

simData.note: KT 30-day prepaid: 15 GB then unlimited at 3 Mbps, plus 100 minutes, KRW 39,600 (reseller page).

misc.note: Gym, jjimjilbang/spa, toiletries, entertainment, buffer. Set between Taipei ($180) and Tbilisi-tier cities, below Osaka ($200).

accomSeasonality._doc: Editorial. The short-let market spikes in the Jul–Aug beach season and dips in winter; spring blossom and the Sep–Oct Chuseok and film-festival period add a small uplift.
